cards.heading: More detail — inverter CT delta history

cards.content: Two instruments measuring the same wire: the EM16P clamps and the inverter's own CTs over RS485. The dashed delta should sit near the ~20 W meter offset — sustained drift means a loose or lying clamp (ch11, July) or CT saturation at high load.
